description:
Ask ALICE, Palm Coast Local's AI guide, about Palm Coast and Flagler County, Florida.

    Covers local businesses and services (plumbers, HVAC, doctors, restaurants, hotels...),
    upcoming events, deals, schools, golf, beaches, government and community information.
    Multi-part questions work ("going to the fall festival and want dinner after").
    Returns ALICE's own answer plus the matching Palm Coast Local listings with phone,
    address, hours and page links.

    Args:
        question: The visitor's question in plain language.
name: ask_alice
title: Ask ALICE (Palm Coast Local)
